stage_prediction_policy: Released two-stage native outputs; strict gating, unverified on these candidate masks; crop-sensitivity retained.
class_stats_scope: Complete whole-slide usable linked masks with frozen v15 calls; candidate-level explanations and prior surrogate/intervention results remain unchanged.
coverage_policy: All whole-slide lattice cores processed; empty predicted fields have no contours.

tissue_gate.policy: Display admission only. Pinned VitaminP _calculate_tissue_percentage on unnormalised512px RGB, threshold0.1, OR every original valid-nucleus core, then one-core3x3 dilation. Raw masks and measurements are retained; a viewer toggle exposes background-rejected predictions.
tissue_gate.brightfield_rule: RGB→gray;7x7Gaussian blur; dark pixels≤210. Original method selects modality by mean gray>100.

v15_scope: Every original analysis-valid supplied nucleus has a frozen v15 posterior; all previously published rows remain bit-exact. Historical whole-slide calls remain a separate colour option.
